verdict.rationale: Vercel provides preview environments per Git push and Vercel Sandbox for running untrusted/ephemeral code, which together support testing without touching production, but evidence doesn't explicitly frame this as an AI-agent-driven sandbox testing workflow separate from prod data isolation guarantees. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of data isolation from production databases/state in preview environments, independent/hands-on verification of sandbox safety, and AI-native framing of the sandbox-vs-prod separation.
